disposition: T12 candidate not accepted; rework sent to existing OpenCode session

findings.problem: Parked dispatch recovery is not reachable through production UI
findings.evidence: retry_dispatch_admission is referenced only by its definition and dispatch_admission_qa. footer_activity displays only storage_error; retry_pending_saves does not call dispatch recovery, and retry_live_persistence only calls adapter.retry_live. dispatch_admission_error has no visible consumer.
findings.required_fix: Expose truthful compact failure feedback and a real retry action wired to the exact retained dispatch; wake and notify on retirement early-return paths too.
findings.acceptance: Click the real retry control for a representative parked failure; exact run recovers once, no new run identity, persistence settles and pump idles.

findings.problem: Proposed large history native fixture has only 193 runs for 43,200 periods
findings.evidence: r156-large-history-data/manifest.json reports 43,200 occurrences, 30,240 Succeeded but 193 run bodies.
findings.required_fix: Use actual large-run fixture or seed valid per-succeeded-period report links and substantive synthetic bodies. Retain disabled schedules and zero recovery/runnable work.
findings.acceptance: Read-only integrity, counts and report ownership checks before root changes isolated bootstrap.
